components.name: Button
components.props: text (required: the label, or the accessible name when children are passed), children (shown instead of text: an icon, a rich label), onPress, variant, isLoading, isDisabled, small, Icon

components.name: Card
components.props: fluid (sizes to content and container; default fixed 328x200), round, hover; padding with className="p-6"

components.name: Box
components.props: fixed 328x200 by default: className="h-auto w-full"

components.name: Modal
components.props: isOpen, onOpenChange(open), fluid (sizes to its content; default fixed 328x200); no title prop

components.name: Tag
components.props: text (required: the label, or the accessible name when children are passed), children (shown instead of text, e.g. a dot and a label), active, toggle (announces active as pressed), onPress (react-aria Button); for coloured statuses use kit StatusBadge

components.name: Tabs
components.props: items: {id, text, value, content}[], callback(key, value)

components.name: Tooltip
components.props: text, place, small, children

components.name: Switch
components.props: react-aria Switch props (isSelected, onChange), small

components.name: Checkbox
components.props: react-aria Checkbox props (isSelected, onChange), label, small

components.name: Radio
components.props: options: {label, value}[], groupLabel, onChange(value)

components.name: CustomRadio
components.props: items: {value, content (a node, or (renderProps) => node)}[], or children (CustomRadioItem elements, with a field or tooltip beside them), groupLabel, value, onChange(value). For options that are a label only, use Radio

components.name: CustomRadioItem
components.props: value, children ((renderProps) => node); one option among CustomRadio's children. It renders a <label>: put a field or a tooltip beside it, not inside

components.name: RadioIndicator
components.props: the library's radio circle for CustomRadio content: spread the option's render props (isSelected, isHovered, isFocusVisible, ...), small, focusRing={false} when the option shows its own focus ring

components.name: Steps
components.props: items: {title, subitems?}[], currentItemIndex. Step indicator only; for a multi-step form use kit WizardShell

components.name: Timeline
components.props: items: {title, party, subtitle, variant?}[] (non-empty)

components.name: CustomTimeline
components.props: items with custom content

components.name: Accordion
components.props: items: {title, body, Icon?}[], defaultExpanded

components.name: CustomAccordion
components.props: items: {title (any node), body, expandButton?}[], defaultExpanded, expandButton({expanded, toggle}) for every item. For a text title with an icon use Accordion. The expand button sits inside the header's button, so return an icon, not a Button

components.name: Breadcrumb
components.props: items, callback, clickable, variant

components.name: Copiable
components.props: copiableContent, info, iconPlacement, children

components.name: Form
components.props: react-aria Form props (onSubmit, validationErrors, validationBehavior); fields with name, a Button with type="submit", and kit FormStack for the layout. Inside a kit WizardShell step, no Form: the shell is the form

components.name: Searchbar
components.props: label, placeholder, onChange(value: string); 278 px wide: className="w-full" fills the column

components.name: TextField
components.props: label, onChange(value: string), variant="error", message; 278 px wide: className="w-full" fills the column

components.name: TextArea
components.props: label, onChange(value: string)

components.name: NumberField
components.props: react-aria NumberField props (value, onChange(number)), label, variant, message

components.name: BigNumberField
components.props: onChange(v: BigNumber in display units): keep v.toFixed() as a string and convert it with kit parseUnits on submit, not in onChange (the field swallows its throw); minValue="0", validate (at most the token's decimals), showFieldError

components.name: Datepicker
components.props: react-aria DatePicker props (value, onChange), time, label

components.name: DropdownSelect
components.props: items: {id, text, itemValue}[], callback(item); the trigger is 240 px and no prop widens it; its list calls Date.now() (SimpleBar), so a fixed-clock app uses Radio for a short list

components.name: DropdownCascader
components.props: items: {label, value, children}[]

components.name: Slider
components.props: react-aria Slider props, leftLabel, rightLabel, formatter, callback

components.name: FileUploader
components.props: callback(file: File), msg, variant

components.name: FileViewer
components.props: url, fileName

components.name: AlertMessage
components.props: variant (success|warning|error|info), title, msg (required); no children

components.name: PushMessage
components.props: variant, title, msg, callback

components.name: LinearProgress
components.props: value (0-100); width (px) optional: leave it out to fill the container

components.name: CircularProgress
components.props: value; tone (success|warning|error|info|neutral|accent) sets the fill colour, default blue turning green at 100%; aria-label names it

components.name: StandardPagination
components.props: currentPage (from 1), numPages, callback(page)

components.name: CompactPagination
components.props: currentPage, numPages, callback(page)

components.name: ScrollbarContainer
components.props: children

components.name: DraggableList
components.props: items, callback (see its .d.ts)

components.name: DisplayLarge
components.props: text, label, Icon

components.name: DisplaySmall
components.props: text, label, Icon

components.name: DisplayIcon
components.props: text, label, Icon (required, in a small card on the left); fixed 288x80 px like DisplayLarge. For an app's stat row prefer kit StatCard

components.name: Skeleton
components.props: count, className; for whole data views prefer QueryState

components.name: Spinner
components.props: size, label

components.name: EmptyState
components.props: title, description, action ({text, onPress} for a small Button, or a node rendered as given), icon

components.name: InfoCard
components.props: children, variant (info|warning|success|error; also sets its icon and the word screen readers hear first)

components.name: StatCard
components.props: label, value, hint, icon, isLoading

components.name: AddressDisplay
components.props: address, chars, explorerUrl (adds a ↗ link to the explorer beside the address), copyInfo

components.name: TokenAmount
components.props: value (the token's smallest unit, wei for ETH: bigint or integer string; a decimal amount goes through parseUnits first), symbol, decimals, maxFractionDigits (default 4; a non-zero amount below its last digit shows as <0.0001, <0.01 for 2, not 0)

components.name: DataTable
components.props: columns: DataTableColumn<T>[] (key, header, render, align, width: px or a CSS width, so columns keep their place while loading), rows, rowKey, isLoading, empty, onRowPress (a click, or Enter or Space on the focused row; a click on a link or button in the row is left to it)

components.name: ExternalLink
components.props: href, children

components.name: HelpTooltip
components.props: text, children (a plain-text label also names the "?": "About" and the label), place

components.name: ThemeToggle
components.props: no props; follows the .dark class (useDarkMode), so it stays in step with other code; the word Dark toggles it too; call kit applyInitialTheme() in main.tsx before the first render (?theme=light or ?theme=dark, else the system setting)

components.name: ChainGuard
components.props: isConnected, isConnecting (a spinner instead of the connect or switch prompt while the wallet connects or reconnects), chainId, requiredChainId, chainName, onConnect, onSwitchChain, children

components.name: applyInitialTheme
components.description: Sets the starting theme before the first render: `?theme=light` or `?theme=dark` in the URL wins, else the system setting. Call it once in `main.tsx`.

components.name: Sparkline
components.description: Small line chart of one series: a filled area, a line and a dot on the latest value, with optional start and end labels.

components.name: KeyValueList
components.description: Facts as label and value rows (a `dl`) with a divider between rows, inside a `Card` or alone.

components.name: FormField
components.description: Label, help and error text around a custom control (a chain picker, a token selector, a file drop).

components.name: WizardShell
components.description: Multi-step form: the core `Steps` bar above the current step's fields in a `FormStack`, with Back, Next and Submit in its actions.

components.name: Stack
components.description: Vertical flex column with a fixed gap. Use it instead of hand-written `flex flex-col gap-*` or margins on children.

components.name: Inline
components.description: Horizontal row that wraps, with a fixed gap. For button rows, tag lists and label + value pairs.

components.name: Grid
components.description: Responsive grid: as many columns of at least `minItemWidth` as the row holds, with the items filling the row, so no empty column is left at its end. No breakpoints needed.

components.name: Section
components.description: Titled block of a page: heading, optional description and actions, then content.

components.name: Page
components.description: Page container: centred, max width, responsive gutters, vertical padding. Renders a `main` element.

components.name: FormStack
components.description: Vertical stack of form fields with an optional actions row. Use inside the core `Form` or a plain `form`; in a `WizardShell` step, pass the fields alone (the shell is the form and its FormStack).

components.name: ErrorState
components.description: Error block for a failed load: core `AlertMessage` plus an optional Retry button.

components.name: QueryState
components.description: Handles the loading, error, empty and loaded states of one request in a single place.

components.name: StatusBadge
components.description: Small pill for a status, such as a case period or a transaction state.

components.name: useCountdown
components.description: Time left until a deadline: live (re-rendered every second), or computed from a fixed `now` with no timer, for mocks and stories.

components.name: Countdown
components.description: Time left until a deadline, in a `time` element with the UTC time as its tooltip: live, or static text from a fixed `now` (mocks, stories, screenshots).

components.name: readToken
components.description: Current value of a colour token as a CSS colour string, for charts and canvas that cannot use Tailwind classes.

knownGaps.name: Period / status tag with colour
knownGaps.compose: kit StatusBadge with a tone per period (evidence info, commit neutral, vote accent, appeal warning, execution success)

knownGaps.name: Segmented control
knownGaps.compose: core Tabs for content switching, or core Radio for a value
